stem: Based on the information in the check register, what was the balance of Raúl’s checking account after the transaction on April 13 in dollars and cents?
instruction: Record your answer and fill in the bubbles on your answer document. Be sure to use the correct place value.
visual_elements: Raúl’s Check Register Table with transactions dated 4/2 (Gas debit card withdrawal 35.50), 4/6 (Shirt check withdrawal 23.75), and 4/13 (Money from Mom check deposit 55.00). Starting balance on 4/2 is 539.50.
